arxiv-2110-09747.title: Studying QCD modeling of uncertainties in particle spectra from dark-matter annihilation into jets
arxiv-2110-09747.creator: Adil Jueid
arxiv-2110-09747.description: Abstract Motivated by various excesses observed by the Fermi-LAT and AMS collaborations, we perform a detailed analysis of QCD uncertainties on particle spectra from dark-matter annihilation (or decay) into jets. When annihilated to SM particles, the final-state annihilation products undergo various complicated processes such as QED and QCD bremsstrahlung, hadronisation, and hadron decays.

arxiv-2112-01150.title: The role of photon-number pulses in the operation of a simple light diode
arxiv-2112-01150.creator: Zakarya Lasmar, Shuaijie Li, Valerio Scarani
arxiv-2112-01150.description: Abstract One of the challenges faced by optical platforms for quantum technologies is the implementation of (ultimately) a transistor. The functionality that is hard to achieve is rectification: having the beam propagating in one direction transmitted, the other reflected. Here we take up a simple model of such a rectifying device, a.k.a.

arxiv-2211-09055.title: A constant lower bound for the union-closed sets conjecture
arxiv-2211-09055.creator: Justin Gilmer
arxiv-2211-09055.description: Abstract We show that for any union-closed family ℱ ⊆ 2 [ n ] , ℱ ≠ { ∅ } \mathcal{F}\subseteq 2^{[n]},\mathcal{F}\neq\{\emptyset\} , there exists an i ∈ [ n ] i\in[n] which is contained in a 0.01 0.01 fraction of the sets in ℱ \mathcal{F} .

arxiv-2302-10759.title: Micromagnetic study of inertial spin waves in ferromagnetic nanodots
arxiv-2302-10759.creator: Massimiliano d’Aquino, Salvatore Perna, Matteo Pancaldi, Riccardo Hertel, Stefano Bonetti, Claudio Serpico
arxiv-2302-10759.description: Abstract Here we report the possibility to excite ultra-short spin waves in ferromagnetic thin-films by using time-harmonic electromagnetic fields with terahertz frequency. Such ultra-fast excitation requires to include inertial effects in the description of magnetization dynamics. In this respect, we consider the inertial Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (iLLG) equation and develop analytical theory for exchange-dominated inertial spin waves.

arxiv-2305-05790.title: Inferences from surface brightness fluctuations of Zwicky 3146 via the Sunyaev-Zel’dovich effect and X-ray observations Facilities: GBT, XMM Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; The Astropy Collaboration 2018 ) , pyproffit ( Eckert et al. 2017 ) , emcee ( Foreman-Mackey et al. 2013 ) , ESAS
arxiv-2305-05790.creator: Charles E. Romero, Massimo Gaspari, Gerrit Schellenberger, Tanay Bhandarkar, Mark Devlin, Simon R. Dicker, William Forman, Rishi Khatri, Ralph Kraft, Luca Di Mascolo, Brian S. Mason, Emily Moravec, Tony Mroczkowski, Paul Nulsen, John Orlowski-Scherer, Karen Perez Sarmiento, Craig Sarazin, Jonathan S
arxiv-2305-05790.description: Abstract The galaxy cluster Zwicky 3146 is a sloshing cool core cluster at z = 0.291 z{=}0.291 that in SZ imaging does not appear to exhibit significant pressure substructure in the intracluster medium (ICM). We perform a surface brightness fluctuation analysis via Fourier amplitude spectra on SZ (MUSTANG-2) and X-ray ( XMM-Newton ) images of this cluster.

arxiv-2307-04038.title: Prediction of short stellar activity cycles using derived and established empirical relations between activity and rotation periods.
arxiv-2307-04038.creator: A. k. Althukair ID, D. Tsiklauri ID
arxiv-2307-04038.description: Abstract In our previous work, we investigated the occurrence rate of super-flares on various types of stars and their statistical properties, with a particular focus on G-type dwarfs, using entire Kepler data. The said study also considered how the statistics change with stellar rotation period, which in turn, had to be determined.

arxiv-2405-04862.title: On Degenerations of the Projective Plane
arxiv-2405-04862.creator: Jürgen HAUSEN a, Katharina KIRÁLY a and Milena WROBEL b
arxiv-2405-04862.description: Abstract Complementing results of Hacking and Prokhorov, we determine in an explicit manner all log terminal, rational, degenerations of the projective plane that allow a non-trivial torus action. keywords degenerations of the plane; Markov numbers; del Pezzo surfaces; torus action AMS 14L30; 14J26; 14J10; 14D06 † † shorttitle: On Degenerations of the Projective Plane † † runningauthor: J. Hausen, K.

arxiv-2406-16350.title: A Survey on Intent-aware Recommender Systems Journal: TORS Volume: 1 1 1 1 DOI: 10.1145/3700890 CCS: Information systems Recommender systems
arxiv-2406-16350.creator: Dietmar Jannach, Markus Zanker
arxiv-2406-16350.description: Abstract . Many modern online services feature personalized recommendations. A central challenge when providing such recommendations is that the reason why an individual user accesses the service may change from visit to visit or even during an ongoing usage session.

arxiv-2412-05968.title: LVS-Net: A Lightweight Vessels Segmentation Network for Retinal Image Analysis
arxiv-2412-05968.creator: Mehwish Mehmood, Shahzaib Iqbal, Tariq Mahmood Khan, Ivor Spence, Muhammad Fahim
arxiv-2412-05968.description: Abstract The analysis of retinal images for the diagnosis of various diseases is one of the emerging areas of research. Recently, the research direction has been inclined towards investigating several changes in retinal blood vessels in subjects with many neurological disorders, including dementia.

arxiv-2601-04947.title: Tunable Quantum Interference in Free Space with a Liquid-Crystal Metagrating
arxiv-2601-04947.creator: Maria Gorizia Ammendola, Italo Machuca Flores, Sneha Dey, Francesco Di Colandrea, Andrei Nomerotski, Bereneice Sephton, Carlo Schiano, Corrado de Lisio, Vincenzo D’Ambrosio, Lorenzo Marrucci, Patrick Cameron, Filippo Cardano
arxiv-2601-04947.description: Abstract Structured optical materials provide a promising platform for photonic quantum information processing in free space. Beam splitters, a fundamental building block of photonic circuits, have recently been demonstrated in free space using geometric-phase optical elements. These devices coherently mix circularly-polarized transverse modes of freely-propagating optical fields, including modes carrying orbital angular momentum.

arxiv-2601-14528.title: LLM Security and Safety: Insights from Homotopy-Inspired Prompt Obfuscation
arxiv-2601-14528.creator: Luis Lazo, Hamed Jelodar, Roozbeh Razavi-Far
arxiv-2601-14528.description: Abstract In this study, we propose a homotopy-inspired prompt obfuscation framework to enhance understanding of security and safety vulnerabilities in Large Language Models (LLMs). By systematically applying carefully engineered prompts, we demonstrate how latent model behaviors can be influenced in unexpected ways.

pmc-10650194.title: Novel Carboxylation Method for Polyetheretherketone (PEEK) Surface Modification Using Friedel–Crafts Acylation
pmc-10650194.creator: Xinghui Lyu, Ryuhei Kanda, Susumu Tsuda, Yoshiya Hashimoto, Takamasa Fujii, Kosuke Kashiwagi
pmc-10650194.description: Recently, polyetheretherketone (PEEK) has shown promising dental applications. Surface treatment is essential for dental applications owing to its poor surface energy and wettability; however, no consensus on an effective treatment method has been achieved. In this study, we attempted to carboxylate PEEK sample surfaces via Friedel–Crafts acylation using succinic anhydride and AlBr3.

pmc-11311292.title: Circulating Tumor Cells: Pathological, Molecular and Functional Characteristics
pmc-11311292.creator: Ewa A Grzybowska
pmc-11311292.description: nce of CTC Enumeration and Molecular Analysis in the Clinic and for Basic Research The enumeration and molecular analysis of circulating tumor cells (CTCs) is gaining importance in both clinical studies and in basic research concerning the mechanisms of metastasis.

pmc-11491064.title: Long-Term Outcomes of Traditional Chinese Medicine in the Treatment of Granulomatous Lobular Mastitis: A Two-Year Follow-Up Study on Recurrence and New Occurrence Rates with Analysis of Risk Factors
pmc-11491064.creator: Ciyi Hua, Feifei Li, Youyang Shi, Yuan Xu, Mengdie Zhu, Yang Wang, Xiqiu Zhou, Sheng Liu
pmc-11491064.description: BackgroundPatients with clinically cured granulomatous lobular mastitis (GLM) still face a high probability of recurrence and new occurrence.PurposeTo evaluate the long-term efficacy of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) in treating GLM and to hypothesize potential risk factors for recurrence or new occurrence.

pmc-11671828.title: Prevalence and Clinical Aspects of Trichomonas vaginalis Infection among High-Risk Women in Karaj, Iran
pmc-11671828.creator: Amir Bairami, Kourosh Kabir, Behrouz Abbasi Alaei, Saeed Bahadory, Mostafa Rezaeian
pmc-11671828.description: Background:Trichomoniasis is a common sexually transmitted infection (STI) caused by the protozoan Trichomonas vaginalis, which causes health and emotional damages to the sufferers annually. We aimed to investigate the prevalence of T. vaginalis and its related risk factors among the high-risk women in the city of Karaj, central Iran.Methods:This cross-sectional study was conducted between October 2021 and September 2022.

pmc-12581810.title: The two faces of MyoD: repressor and activator of gene expression during myogenesis
pmc-12581810.creator: Carmen Birchmeier
pmc-12581810.description: In this Outlook, Birchmeier discusses a study by Nicoletti et al. in this issue of Genes & Development that reports that MYOD unconventionally serves as a transcriptional repressor of nonmyogenic fates. Birchmeier highlights the duality of MYOD function as both an activator and a repressor of gene expression that together modulate the myogenic program during muscle development and regeneration.

pmc-13061973.title: A combined PBL and flipped classroom intervention enhances self-directed learning ability and empathy in ophthalmology undergraduates
pmc-13061973.creator: Yu Yang, Jiarui Xue, Lingfei Hu, Kai Fang, Chaobing Wei, Changfan Wu, Huixiang Jin
pmc-13061973.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). To evaluate the effectiveness of combining problem-based learning with the flipped classroom (PBL-FC) teaching method in the “Ocular Trauma” module in ophthalmology education, specifically in enhancing clinical medicine students’ self-directed learning ability and empathy. A quasi-experimental study with a controlled educational intervention was conducted, and third-year clinical medicine students from eight classes were divided into PBL-FC (n = 43) and traditional groups (n = 44). Both groups were assessed before and after class using Self-Directed Learning Ability and Empathy Quotient (EQ)-40 scales.

pmc-13088565.title: Neuropsychological profile and clinical benefits of multimodal interventions in a child with ADHD, Generalized Anxiety Disorder, and Social (Pragmatic) Communication Disorder within the context of intellectual giftedness: a case report
pmc-13088565.creator: Andrea Battisti, Cristiana Varuzza, Giulia Brunozzi, Giulia Lazzaro, Pietro De Rossi, Stefano Vicari, Deny Menghini
pmc-13088565.description: BackgroundIn recent years, particular interest has been directed toward the topic of intellectual giftedness. An IQ above 130, typically assessed with standardized cognitive scales, is a widely recognized criterion for giftedness. Gifted children often face emotional and socio-relational difficulties, particularly anxiety, due to perfectionism and high-performance pressures.

pmc-13266462.title: Case Report: Percutaneous closure of patent ductus arteriosus with the KONAR-MF™ device: initial experience and results at 6 months in a tertiary center
pmc-13266462.creator: Alex Ismael Catalán Cabrera, Mónica Karem Medina Durand, Karen del Rosario Condori Alvino, Cesar Augusto Puma Laura, Norma Maribel Portilla Marroquin
pmc-13266462.description: BackgroundPatent ductus arteriosus (PDA) results in pulmonary overcirculation and, depending on ductal size and patient age, may lead to symptoms of congestive heart failure and the development of pulmonary hypertension, among other complications. Percutaneous closure is currently considered the first-line option in most patients, depending on clinical and anatomical characteristics.

pmc-13327475.title: Integrating Prostate‐Specific Antigen Density and Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System Scores to Optimize Detection of Clinically Significant Prostate Cancer: A Multivariable Risk Model Approach
pmc-13327475.creator: Yunus Kayali
pmc-13327475.description: BackgroundPrebiopsy multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) reported using the Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System (PI‐RADS) improves prostate cancer triage, yet false‐positive findings remain common and may drive unnecessary biopsy. Prostate‐specific antigen density (PSAD) is an inexpensive laboratory‐derived adjunct that may refine MRI‐based risk stratification.

pmc-13404855.title: Protocol for the Parent Anxiety Transmission and Habits (PATH) study: a randomised controlled trial testing parent interpretation bias as a key mechanism of intergenerational transmission of anxiety
pmc-13404855.creator: Margaret A Chiffer, Daniel P Dickstein, Roni Itkin-Ofer, Jennie M Kuckertz, Boyu Ren, Doah E Shin, Alexandra L Silverman, Christian A Webb, Courtney Beard
pmc-13404855.description: IntroductionAnxiety disorders are the most common youth mental health problems in the USA. Most children do not receive treatment and among the few who do, many do not experience significant improvement. Thus, there is an urgent need to identify novel intervention targets to improve treatments for childhood anxiety.

pmc-13439907.title: Modeling suicidal thoughts and behaviors in university students: integrating suicide theory with interpretable machine learning
pmc-13439907.creator: Li-Chung Lin, Chih-Han Leng, Grace Yao
pmc-13439907.description: University students are at risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors (STB), with prevalence rates higher than those in the general population. Machine learning (ML) enhances the accuracy of STB prediction and provides new possibilities and explanatory frameworks for this issue.

pmc-13446004.title: The role of physical therapy in the treatment of lipedema: an integrative review of therapeutic strategies and the current clinical landscape
pmc-13446004.creator: Débora Aparecida Oliveira Modena, Jaqueline Munaretto Timm Baiocchi, Elaine Caldeira de Oliveira Guirro
pmc-13446004.description: Lipedema is a chronic disorder characterized by a disproportionate accumulation of subcutaneous adipose tissue in the extremities, typically sparing the hands and feet. It is commonly associated with pain, hypersensitivity, easy bruising, edema, and fibrotic nodules. Despite growing awareness, there is still no consensus on evidence-based therapeutic approaches.

pmc-13553957.title: Exploratory segmentation of selected cardiovascular hospital services in Chile using DRG-based normalized indicators
pmc-13553957.creator: José Rodríguez, Manuel Vargas, Pilar Cos, Andrés Viveros
pmc-13553957.description: ObjectiveTo assess the use of DRG-based normalized indicators in supporting an exploratory analysis of inter-hospital variation in specific cardiovascular services within the Chilean public system from 2019 to 2023, employing routinely collected administrative data and confining interpretation to descriptive comparisons within the examined sample. The study was designed as descriptive and hypothesis-generating, not to validate hospital performance measures.
